name: updated-at-field-patch-keeps-server-authority
$comment: Server-stamped updatedAtField (FM-36) on the patch path: a patch supplying its own updatedAt value cannot leave it in the doc — the server stamps the merged row. Determinism: the follow-up read filters updatedAt > 123, so a doc carrying the client's literal 123 (or no value at all) would be invisible; only a server stamp (wall-clock epoch-ms) matches. Also pins that the stamp survives a patch that does not otherwise mention the field.
